text:
Alex W: Hey team — Datadog + OTEL roadshow next week, want to make sure our demo app + dashboard are solid. Quick sync?
Priya S: yes please. who from eng can pair on the lightweight agent demo?
Sam (eng): I can take the agent hookup. want to show minimal traces + metrics for a private deployment (VPC) and hosted case.
Jens: for SI audience we should have two decks: integration flow (OTLP -> Datadog) and troubleshooting runbook. keep it under 15m each.
Marcos: agreed. also need a one-pager with supported config snippets (k8s daemonset, sidecar, and our private onprem installer). I can draft.
Alex W: perfect. Priya can you lead GTM talking points + value props for partners (reliability, cost visibility, model traceability)?
Priya S: yes — i'll add a slide about our trace enrichment (model_id, version, prompt_id) and how it maps to Datadog tags. want sample JSON mapping for the demo.
Sam (eng): putting together a tiny sample. snippet below for OTLP exporter config we plan to show:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<redacted>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Jens: nice. for the private deployment path note we need to show an on-prem proxy that forwards to Datadog (air-gapped customers will use bundle export). add that to the runbook.
Marcos: timeline? I can have drafts by EOD Tuesday.
Alex W: roadmap for prep:
- Tue EOD: draft one-pager + config snippets (Marcos, Sam)
- Wed AM: dry-run of demo (Sam, Jens, Alex)
- Wed PM: record a 6m video clip for partner portal (Priya)
- Thu: final slide deck + SI handoff
Priya S: i'll own the partner email + marketplace blurb. need the demo recording link by Wed PM.
Sam (eng): quick note: the runtime needs a small env var to enable trace enrichment: `REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true`. will include in demo script.
Datadog-bot: integration-check: OTLP endpoint reachable from demo cluster — PASS
Marcos: thanks. i'll put initial files in the shared drive and ping channel when ready. tagging @Priya S and @Sam (eng) for visibility :thumbsup:
Alex W: great — meeting tomorrow 10:30PT to walk through. calendar invite sent. :calendar:
